verdict.rationale: incident.io documents Workflows that automatically act on events, such as publishing to the status page when an incident is updated. Further evidence shows rule-based escalation paths keyed on priority and working hours, alert routing by team or service, and two-way ticket sync that updates on changes. Event-triggered auto-creation of incidents from monitors and auto-starting Teams meetings add to this. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the Workflows trigger/condition/action builder (only one example is evidenced), any AI-native or agent-driven rule authoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
